title: the-briefing-surface-is-charter-plus-state-never-history
intention: The briefing surface — what a cold reader loads at a component's address — is charter plus state, never history. Charter (intention+why.json), state (compiled from tickets), proofs and validations. History under way stays beside the code (Law 5); past that, commons.
why: child of an-artifact-is-present-tense-or-past-tense-never-both: a cold reader arriving at a component sees the authored design and the standing state of play. History narrative in default context is noise that forces re-derivation (Law 1) and misses what IS right now.
traces_to: Law 5 — intent, its current state, and its proofs share an address, and the address carries what a mind needs NOW, not everything that ever happened.
Law 1 — the resolver is spent on the novel, not on re-deriving the settled. History at the briefing surface forces re-derivation.
Law 7 — deliberately KEPT: records of truth stay append-only, only their default-loadedness changes.

proves_green.proof_gate: quorum signature gate — Akien reviews the canonical definition and judges whether it captures the briefing surface as designed.

falsifier.proves_red: Done when the briefing surface definition is written and clear enough that a builder knows what to put at the address and what to move to the commons. Wrong-intent if a cold reader demonstrably needs history narrative at the briefing surface more than the noise costs.

watchme: none, because the parent's probe at cairn/tools/intentions_model_compiler/probes/present_tense_artifacts_carry_no_dated_appends.py watches the population — this concept defines what the probe should catch, not a second measurement surface
chart_claim: none, because concept-piece — the build IS the prose definition, and the exit gate for concept-pieces is the quorum review, not the chart chain

definition.what: The briefing surface is what a cold reader loads at a component's address. It is the minimum a mind needs to tell what is going on WITHOUT leaving the component's directory.
composition: charter (intention+why.json) — the summarized design: authored, the settled why+role, changes only when the design shifts. The filename forces the why (CP3 as schema, not as a field someone can leave blank).
state — compiled from the component's tickets; never hand-edited. The standing state of play: what is cast, what is building, what is proved.
proofs/ and the validations that sealed them — the evidence that the code does what the charter says.
code — the implementation itself, co-located with its charter.
definition.what_is_excluded: History. History of what is UNDER WAY stays beside the code and is usually short (Law 5). History past that migrates to the commons — kept and greppable, never destroyed, but not at the briefing surface. The purpose sets the bound: the repo is itself the state of the machine (Akien, 2026-08-17), and the address carries what a mind needs NOW, not everything that ever happened.
definition.the_cut: The cut is not by kind of content — it is by whether the thing still helps, and for how long. 'We keep together things that are helpful. For as long as they're helpful' (Akien, 2026-08-17). A ticket's voyage freezes in component history when it proves out, and moves to the commons once it no longer establishes what is going on right now.
definition.why_this_matters: A cold reader arriving at a component sees the authored design (charter) and the standing state of play (state). History narrative at the briefing surface forces re-derivation (Law 1) and misses what IS right now. The briefing surface is for the present tense; the commons is for the past tense. A thing and the story of the thing may live in two roots; what they may never do is contradict each other.
definition.the_test: A builder arriving cold at a component's directory can tell what the component is (charter), what state it is in (state), and whether it works (proofs) — without reading history, without leaving the directory, and without loading the commons.
